column1: # Run 44261296408, warm after the revert (b3980fbc9). Read from the GitHub Actions API (job steps) and each job's log.
# image = the 'Version:' line of the log's 'Runner Image' group; provisioner = that of its 'Runner Image Provisioner' group; key = key.sh's first 'key=' line.
# mirror = the most frequent *archive.ubuntu.com host in the log, '-' when none; archive_ubuntu_gets = 'Get:' lines from such a host; browser_action_s = the 'Run ./.github/actions/browser' step.
